title: Murder
description: Culpable homicide amounting to murder, punishable with death or life imprisonment.

title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
description: Causing death without the intent/knowledge required for murder.

title: Cheating
description: Deceiving a person to dishonestly induce delivery of property or to do/omit an act.

title: Cheating by personation
description: Cheating by pretending to be another person, including online impersonation.

title: Theft
description: Dishonestly taking movable property out of another's possession without consent.

title: Robbery
description: Theft or extortion committed with force or threat of force.

title: Extortion
description: Dishonestly inducing a person to deliver property by putting them in fear of injury.

title: Criminal intimidation
description: Threatening a person with injury to person, reputation, or property to cause alarm.

title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage modesty
description: Assault or criminal force against a woman intending to outrage her modesty.

title: Rape
description: Sexual assault as defined under the section, punishable with rigorous imprisonment.

title: Kidnapping
description: Kidnapping from India or from lawful guardianship.

title: Forgery
description: Making a false document or electronic record with intent to cause damage or fraud.

title: Criminal conspiracy
description: Two or more persons agreeing to commit an illegal act or a legal act by illegal means.

title: Mischief causing damage
description: Causing wrongful loss or damage to property with intent or knowledge.

title: Recording of information in cognizable cases (FIR)
description: Procedure for registering an FIR for a cognizable offence, including electronic complaints.

title: Procedure for investigation
description: Police procedure for investigating a case after an FIR is registered.

title: Search and seizure procedure
description: Procedure for search of a place and seizure of property/evidence.

title: Admissibility of electronic/digital records
description: Conditions under which electronic records (call data, messages, CCTV, etc.) are admissible as evidence.

title: Certificate for electronic evidence
description: Requirement of a certificate to accompany electronic evidence for admissibility.

title: Identity theft
description: Fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's identifying feature (password, digital signature, etc.).

title: Cheating by personation using computer resource
description: Cheating by impersonation carried out through a computer resource or communication device.
